title: MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
abstract: arXiv:2611.33119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate parallel programs, but their correctness and performance depend strongly on the instructions that guide generation. We present \textsc{MetaFORGE}, an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation. \textsc{MetaFORGE} combines correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static-analysis findings, runtime measurements, and rank-level load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward that drives textual-gradient refinement, while an external memory distills and retrieves reward-supported optimization knowledge across runs.   Across six MPI tasks and three workload sizes, \textsc{MetaFORGE} improves static-analysis quality, runtime, and load balance relative to zero-shot generation and generally exceeds the evaluated \textsc{TextGrad} iterative baseline. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成并行程序，但其正确性和性能在很大程度上取决于指导生成过程的指令。我们提出了MetaFORGE，这是一个以执行结果为依据的元学习框架，用于对MPI C代码生成的持久化自然语言技能规范进行迭代优化。MetaFORGE将正确性测试、编译器诊断信息、静态分析结果、运行时性能测量以及进程级负载不均衡概况融合为一个标量奖励，用以驱动文本梯度的精炼过程，同时通过外部记忆在多次运行之间提炼并检索有奖励支撑的优化知识。在六个MPI任务和三种工作负载规模的实验中，相较于零样本生成，MetaFORGE提升了静态分析质量、运行时性能和负载均衡水平，并且总体上超越了所评估的TextGrad迭代基线。一项模型匹配的精炼消融实验表明，MetaFO（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MetaFORGE是一个基于执行反馈的元学习框架，它将正确性测试、编译器诊断、静态分析、运行时测量和负载均衡数据整合为标量奖励，迭代优化自然语言技能规范，从而显著提升LLM生成MPI并行代码的质量、性能与负载均衡。
en_tdlr: MetaFORGE is an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation by fusing correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static analysis, runtime measurements, and load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward, outperforming zero-shot generation and the TextGrad baseline.
